purpose: Display comparable structured records with native table, sort, selection, state, density, visibility, and sticky column support.
accessibility: Use a semantic table with stable row and column context.
Sortable headers expose aria-sort and selection controls have explicit names.
Loading, empty, and error content remains available to assistive technology.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Supports a stacked record presentation on narrow screens when row comparison needs more room than a horizontal table.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: columns
api.description: Column definitions used to render structured data; overflow optionally selects wrap, nowrap, ellipsis, or a two-line clamp. Use nowrap for numeric/action columns, and provide a detail disclosure for clipped text. Stacked records expose the full value.

api.name: rows
api.description: Structured rows rendered by the contract.

api.name: rowKey
api.description: Returns the stable key for each data row.

api.name: columnVisibility
api.description: Configures column visibility for Data Table.

api.name: responsive
api.description: Chooses the narrow-screen presentation; stacked keeps every visible field readable without forcing a wide horizontal table.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending work and prevents duplicate activation.
